verdict.rationale: SDK delivery is Fern's core capability. First-party docs and the GitHub repo describe type-safe, idiomatic SDKs generated in nine languages (TypeScript, Python, Java, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#, and more) from a single API spec, with first-class pagination helpers, and the CLI publishes them. A community comment corroborates the end-to-end SDK experience. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs for Fern's own platform API (the evidence covers SDKs Fern generates for customer APIs), and hands-on reports on SDK quality or usage by AI agents.
